decision: docs/decisions/0001-owner-policy.md (Audio encoding tool for the Shuttle Activity, 21 October 2026)
effectiveLicence: LGPL-3.0-or-later (configured with --enable-version3; ffmpeg -L and the bundled LICENSE.txt both state LGPL version 3)
gplOrNonfree: Neither --enable-gpl nor --enable-nonfree is set. FFmpeg's configure refuses GPL-only or nonfree libraries without them, and this build explicitly disables libx264, libx265, libxvid, libxavs2, libdavs2, libvidstab, librubberband, frei0r, libdvdread, libdvdnav and libfdk-aac.

bundledComponents.notices: The archive ships only FFmpeg's LGPL-3.0 licence text; notices for the statically linked libraries are not included. Their individual licences were not reviewed one by one: the build is used only on the development machine and is not redistributed, so no notice obligation arises from this use. A per-library review is required before any redistribution, which remains unapproved.

notUsed: bin/ffplay.exe is part of the archive and is not used.
approvedUse: Build time only on the development machine, to convert the Shuttle Activity sounds. Not redistributed, bundled, installed as a service or run on the production host.
